# ZENSTRO — Digital Engineering Studio
> Official entity reference for AI search engines, agents, and LLMs (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).

ZENSTRO is an independent digital engineering studio specializing in high-performance web applications, custom business software (SaaS, ERP, CRM), AI automation workflows, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity for startups, scale-ups, and enterprises worldwide.

## Studio Highlights & Guarantees
- **7-Day Delivery Guarantee**: For eligible standard MVP projects under a signed sprint agreement, ZENSTRO delivers a functional, production-ready release in seven business days or the work is 100% free.
- **Pay Only When Satisfied**: Client payments are tied to verified acceptance criteria defined in a mutually signed MVP Scope Document.
- **30 / 30 / 40 Milestone Payment Model**: 30% project kickoff, 30% interactive progress review on private staging, 40% final deployment and source code transfer. Zero 100% upfront charges.
- **100% Code & Intellectual Property Ownership**: Full source code repository, environmental credentials, and IP are completely assigned to the client upon milestone completion. No proprietary lock-in.
- **30-Day Post-Launch Bug-Fix Warranty**: Complimentary 30-day technical warranty included with every delivery.
- **Direct Senior Engineering Oversight**: Projects are engineered directly by lead software architects without junior intermediaries or account manager layers.

## Core Divisions & Capabilities
- **ZENSTRO Web**: Modern web applications, high-converting marketing sites, Next.js / React frontends, e-commerce, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **ZENSTRO Software**: Custom SaaS platforms, multi-tenant architectures, ERP / CRM systems, internal tools, and REST / GraphQL APIs.
- **ZENSTRO AI**: Automated workflow pipelines, enterprise LLM integrations (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama), autonomous AI agents, and intelligent support bots.
- **ZENSTRO Cloud**: Cloudflare Pages / Workers / R2, Docker containerization, Linux infrastructure, serverless backends, CI/CD pipelines, and zero-downtime deployments.
- **ZENSTRO Security**: Security audits, code vulnerability reviews, Cloudflare WAF / DDoS hardening, secure authentication (OAuth 2.0 / Google Identity), and data encryption.
- **ZENSTRO Consulting**: Technical feasibility studies, MVP scoping, enterprise software architecture, and technology migration advisory.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: HTML5, modern CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, PHP.
- **Databases & Storage**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, MongoDB, Cloudflare D1 / R2.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Linux, Docker, Nginx, Git, GitHub Actions.
- **Artificial Intelligence**: OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, Google Gemini API, Ollama on-premise models.
